ev.q: In 2021–2022, the rate for emergency department (ED) visits for children and adolescents with acute upper respiratory infection was 38.6 per 1,000 persons aged <18 years.
the rate for emergency department (ED) visits for children and adolescents with acute upper respiratory infection was 38.6 per 1,000 persons
The ED visit rate was highest for infants aged <1 year (120.5) and decreased by age, with the lowest rate among adolescents aged 12–17 years (14.4).
Estimates are based on a sample of visits to emergency departments in noninstitutional general and short-stay hospitals

methods_quotes.q: Visit rates are based on U.S. Census Bureau estimates of the U.S. civilian, noninstitutionalized population as of July 1 of each year.
With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
